name: Epic Mickey Awesome Edition
storyline: After a mysterious virus attacks the computers of the Function Point team and congregates into an Epic Mickey meme hack, the player controls Greeny through the world of Basedland with the goal of reverting the game to normal. However, due to the unstable nature of the hack's creation, some characters have been more affected than others.
summary: Epic Mickey Awesome edition is a full, Repaint-style meme hack of Epic Mickey for the Wii that recontextualizes the game's story through modded textures, audio, and dialogue.
